description: Source code for the DisplayWGL class implementing WGL (Windows OpenGL) context and surface management, including device initialization, extension handling, context creation, and surface creation for the ANGLE project.

classes.name: FunctionsGLWindows
classes.description: Implementation of FunctionsGL for Windows, loading OpenGL functions via WGL.

classes.name: WorkerContextWGL
classes.description: Worker thread context for WGL, managing PBuffer contexts.

methods.name: GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a human-readable error message for the last Windows error.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WGL display, including loading libraries, creating dummy contexts, and checking extensions.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, releases device contexts, destroys windows, and unloads libraries.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface, optionally using DXGI swap chains.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a PBuffer surface with specified attributes.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a PBuffer surface from a client buffer, initializing D3D device if needed.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::createContext
methods.description: Creates a WGL rendering context, possibly sharing with another context.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::initializeD3DDevice
methods.description: Loads D3D libraries and creates a D3D11 device.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::generateExtensions
methods.description: Populates supported extension flags based on device capabilities.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a specified surface and context current in the calling thread.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::registerD3DDevice
methods.description: Registers a D3D device for interop, opening a handle.

methods.name: DisplayWGL::releaseD3DDevice
methods.description: Releases a registered D3D device handle.
